title: Los Angeles source-of-income discrimination prohibition
requirement: A landlord may not refuse to rent, renew, or terminate a tenancy, or apply different terms, based on a person's source of income, including Section 8 vouchers and other rental assistance.
coverage_conditions: All dwelling units, guest rooms, suites, duplexes, condominiums and single-family residences rented or offered for rent in the City of Los Angeles, including mobile homes.

coverage_quotes: duplexes, condominiums, and single family residences in the City of Los Angeles, rented or offered for rent for living or dwelling purposes

penalty: Aggrieved person may bring a civil action for injunctive relief and damages; punitive damages of at least three times actual damages or three times one month's rent, whichever is higher, plus attorney fees and costs.
quoted_span: A. Based upon a person's source of income, refuse to rent or lease, or to continue to rent or lease, a housing accommodation; refuse to enter into or renew a rental agreement, lease or housing assistance payment contract; refuse to execute any documents required to enter into or renew a rental agreement, lease or housing assistance payment contract;
